ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Use the camera for a Mnelo video call, photo or contact QR scan when you choose.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Use the microphone for Mnelo calls and voice messages when you choose.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose a photo to share on your Mnelo profile or in a conversation.
ios.NSContactsUsageDescription: Choose a contact to invite to Mnelo. Your address book is not uploaded.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Share your current location with this conversation only when you choose.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: Mnelo does not use motion or fitness data. You can deny this permission and continue using all messaging and calling features.
